name: Bronte Capital
summary: Bronte Capital is named in 1 Part of The Buildout, most recently Part 14: The Cash Arrives Unevenly. Argued in Part 14 (The buyers have not paid yet).

sides.sideLabel: The buyers have not paid yet
sides.claim: They say it remains uncertain to them how likely it is that AI spending dramatically slows as Wall Street and the AI funders realise they cannot get a return.

sides.sideLabel: The buyers have not paid yet
sides.claim: They conclude either the AI companies will not earn a return on the trillions they are spending, or they will earn it at the cost of very large short-term unemployment, or most likely a combination of both.
